meta.name: Warehouse — Walls-Only Blockout
meta.mode: Symmetrical 2v2 warehouse layout — stage 1 walls and lighting only
meta.axes: x east, z north, y up; origin at map center; north is +Z
meta.note: Walls-only Stage 1 follows the reference blueprint: four substantial, stepped warehouse chambers with multiple doorways, small perimeter-side service bays, a central combat hall, clear 4m cross-corridors, side loading-dock openings, spawn alcoves, concrete floor markings, and a 4x4 lighting grid. No racks, crates, pallets, containers, vehicles, furniture, roof, or decorative props.
meta.sectionArchitecture: Each numbered quadrant has an enclosing chamber, recessed entry returns, two cross-corridor links, one side-aisle link, and three auxiliary service bays. All quadrant wall geometry is mirrored on both axes.
